Interface Repository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the entity identifier
E - the type of the entity managed, extending Entity
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileRepository, FriendshipDbRepository, FriendshipFileRepository, FriendshipRepository, InMemoryRepository, UtilizatorDbRepository, UtilizatorFileRepository
public interface Repository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>
Generic CRUD interface for managing entities.

  • Method Details

    • findOne

      Optional<E> findOne(ID id)
      Finds an entity by its identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity to find; cannot be null
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the entity if found, or Optional.empty() otherwise
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is null

    • findAll

      Iterable<E> findAll()
      Returns all entities from the repository.
      Returns:
      an iterable collection of all entities

    • findAll

      default List<E> findAll(Predicate<E> filter)
      Finds all entities matching the given filter predicate using Stream API.
      Parameters:
      filter - the predicate used to test each entity; cannot be null
      Returns:
      a list containing all entities that satisfy the predicate
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if filter is null

    • save

      Optional<E> save(E entity)
      Saves an entity in the repository.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to be saved; cannot be null
      Returns:
      Optional.empty() if the entity was saved successfully, or an Optional containing the entity if it already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if entity is null
      ValidationException - if the entity is not valid

    • delete

      Optional<E> delete(ID id)
      Deletes the entity identified by ID from the repository.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity to delete; cannot be null
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the deleted entity if found and removed, or Optional.empty() if no entity exists with the given identifier
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is null
